title: Furnishing an apartment for rent: checklist and budget
seo_title: Furnishing a Rental Apartment: Checklist and Budget
description: Furnishing a buy-to-let apartment: a room-by-room checklist, hard-wearing materials, a budget from $250/m² and furniture sourcing from China.
lead: Furnishing an apartment for rent is not about expensive furniture — it is about the right set: everything needed for daily life, nothing superfluous, easy to maintain and photogenic in the listing. Here is a room-by-room checklist and how to calculate the budget.

body: h2
Who you are furnishing for: the rental format
p

Before writing a furniture list, decide who will rent the apartment. That determines the set, the materials and the budget. A long-term let for a couple or family, short stays for tourists and business travellers, and corporate housing for a company's staff are all different usage scenarios.
ul
long-term let: more storage, a workspace, a full kitchen, a neutral style
short-term let: comfortable beds, hotel-grade textiles, minimal decor that is easy to clean around
corporate housing: workspaces, sturdy furniture, simple cleaning-friendly solutions
p

Tenants choose an apartment from photos, so the interior has to look good in the listing. But they live in it every day, so furniture must be comfortable and durable. A calm base works best — light walls, warm wood tones, plain fabrics — plus a few accents that stand out in the photos.
h2
Checklist: kitchen and living room
p
The kitchen and living room are the hero shots of a listing. Invest in what shows in photos and gets used every day: the sofa, the dining set and the lighting.
ul
a sofa or sofa bed with a removable, washable cover
a coffee table and a TV unit
a dining table and chairs to match the number of beds
kitchen appliances: fridge, hob, oven or microwave, cooker hood, kettle
crockery, cutlery, pots and pans for the number of guests
curtains or blinds, a rug, cushions
general lighting plus a floor or table lamp for the evening

h2
Checklist: bedroom
p

The bedroom should be simple, but with no compromise on the bed and mattress — tenants mention them in reviews more than anything else. One good bed is better than several places to sleep that are uncomfortable.
ul
a bed with a quality mattress and mattress protector
two bedside tables and lighting on both sides of the bed
a wardrobe or open hanging system with hangers
blackout curtains
two sets of bed linen, duvets and pillows
a bedspread and a throw
a full-length mirror
h2
Checklist: entrance hall and bathroom
ul
a wardrobe or coat rack, a shoe shelf, a bench
a mirror and lighting by the entrance
in the bathroom: a backlit mirror, shelves or a vanity unit, hooks, a towel holder
towels: two sets per guest
washing machine, drying rack, iron and ironing board
a vacuum cleaner and basic cleaning kit
p

Small things like hooks, shelves and a mirror are often forgotten, yet they are what makes an apartment convenient. A tenant who has somewhere to hang a towel and put their shoes treats the rest of the space with more care.

h2
Materials that survive renting
p
Furniture in a rental apartment works harder than in your own home. So what matters is not only how it looks but how the material will survive several tenants.
ul
high-durability fabrics and removable sofa covers
worktops and surfaces resistant to moisture, scratches and stains
furniture on sturdy frames without fragile details
identical sets of textiles and crockery that are easy to reorder
neutral colours that show less wear
p
Light fabrics are fine if they have a protective finish or removable covers. For short-term lets, hotel textiles are convenient — white towels and linen that are easy to wash and replace.
h2
How much it costs to furnish a rental apartment
p

Turnkey furnishing of an apartment with us costs from $250 per m². For a 40 m² apartment that is from 40 × $250 = $10,000, for a 60 m² apartment from 60 × $250 = $15,000. This covers selection, specification, ordering, delivery, assembly and placement; the exact estimate depends on the rental format and the items chosen.
p

Some furniture, lighting and textiles are worth sourcing directly from factories in China. In our catalogue, [Ozdoba (in Ukrainian)](/ozdoba), the minimum order starts at $500; items can be combined, and we do not sell single pieces. Delivery takes 30–60 days, so if the apartment is still being renovated, order in parallel with the works.
p
A tip for owners: do not economise on the mattress, lighting and storage — these are what reviews mention most. Decor can be added gradually, once you see how the apartment performs as a rental.

h2
The order of furnishing: from plan to move-in
p

Furnishing is faster and cheaper when decisions are made in the right order. First a furniture plan with dimensions, then the specification, and only then the order. That way furniture is guaranteed to fit its place and the sofa will go through the door and into the lift.
ol
measuring the apartment and photographing its current state
furniture and lighting plan with dimensions
specification: every item with product code, colour and price
budget approval and ordering — from China and locally
delivery, assembly and placement
styling, a photo shoot and handing over the keys
p

If renovation is still under way, make the furniture plan before finishing: sockets, the TV outlet and bedside lighting then end up exactly where the furniture will stand. Moving a socket after wallpapering is an avoidable extra cost.
h2
Styling and photos for the listing
p

Once the furniture is in place, styling remains: a made bed, cushions, a throw, a few books, plants, a laid table. These are inexpensive details, but they turn a furnished apartment into one people want to live in. After styling comes a photo shoot in daylight with the lights on.

faq: How much does it cost to furnish an apartment for rent?
From $250 per m². For a 40 m² apartment that is from $10,000, for 60 m² from $15,000. The exact amount comes from the estimate once items are selected.
What must a rental apartment have?
A comfortable bed with a quality mattress, a sofa, a dining set, basic appliances, storage, bedside lighting, blackout curtains, crockery and two sets of textiles.
Can I order furniture from China for one apartment?
Yes. The minimum order in the Ozdoba catalogue is from $500, and items can be combined. Delivery takes 30–60 days.
Do you style the apartment for listing photos?
Yes. After the furniture is placed we style the apartment — textiles, decor, lighting — so it looks good in photos.
